# Thunderbird Development Dashboard stuck quit and restart

Start with a graceful AppleScript quit and `SIGTERM`; if both leave the dashboard alive, inspect its process tree, force-kill the main PID, then verify the app, backend, and knowledge workers are all gone. [Task 1]

Scope: general.
